# OFFERING MEMORANDUM

## The Maple Court Apartments
### 4820 Maple Court, Dallas, TX 75204

Presented by CBRE Multifamily Capital Markets

---

## INVESTMENT SUMMARY

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Offering Price | $24,500,000 |
| Net Operating Income | $1,485,000 |
| Cap Rate | 6.06% |
| Number of Units | 168 |
| Year Built | 1998 |
| Occupancy | 94.5% |
| Price / Unit | $145,833 |

The Maple Court Apartments is a 168 unit garden-style multifamily community constructed in 1998 and renovated in 2019. The property is currently 94.5% occupied with a trailing-twelve Net Operating Income of $1,485,000, representing a 6.06% capitalization rate on the offering price.

Total 168 units across 12 residential buildings.
